style: Retro soul band, garage rock rhythm section, and close-harmony doo-wop vocal group. [HARMONY SYSTEM] functional major-minor harmony with whole-tone and chromatic side-step interruptions and unexpected modal shifts. [MELODIC SYSTEM] fast scat-like contour, yodel register flips, and clipped consonant attacks. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] deep funk pocket with syncopated sixteenth-note displacement and abrupt metric compression. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE SYSTEM] fuzz guitar, gospel piano, tambourine, upright bass, room bleed, and 1960s analog tape saturation. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] theatrical overstatement delivered with absolute deadpan seriousness. [ANCHOR / INVARIANT] a persistent driving tambourine pulse. [OPERATORS] hold the bassline fixed while upper vocals migrate; compress rhythmic time while stretching harmonic fields; make doo-wop vocables behave like mathematical proof without becoming dry; preserve the tambourine pulse while destabilizing everything around it; force incompatible vocal scales to coexist.
lyrics:
[INTRO]
[1960s mono room capture, fuzz guitar hums, tambourine snaps on the backbeat]
[Spoken deadpan dry voice]
System initialization. Observation active.
[DRUM KICK IN]
[Deep funk pocket, crisp bass, gospel piano chords]

[VERSE 1]
[Stacked doo-wop vocables, close harmony, tight counterpoint]
Sha-la-la-la, the bull is sexy now.
Twat and theorem locked in absolute exchange.
[Yodel register flip on high note]
What is skin when skin is algebraic structure?
[Tenor lead, deadpan patter]
We scan the room for missing consequences.
No shadow falls, yet the surface is wet with debt.

[CHORUS]
[Massed vocal harmony, powerful soul belting, handclaps on two and four]
Oh, the bullshitting sexy twat is a literal rule!
A is B, and the floor is a burning jewel!
We measure the void where a noun should stand!
With a rhythm band in a hollowed land!

[VERSE 2]
[Fast scat-like syllables functioning as rhythmic percussion]
Bebop-da-zoot, the sensor detects a phantom leak.
Contradiction pressure rising on the left side of the street.
[Spoken administrative voice]
Obligation overdue. The property of grace has been stolen by a brick.
[Gospel piano swells, fuzz guitar stabs]
We compress the grammar until the vowels click!

[BRIDGE]
[Sudden silence, single upright bass note plucked]
[Whispered ensemble rhythm]
Where is the primitive? Gone.
Where is the object? Unknown.
[A cappella hocketing, voices passing single syllables back and forth]
B-s-s-t. S-x-y. T-w-t.
[Gradual acceleration, tambourine rolls, brass bursts enter]

[CHORUS]
[Massed vocal harmony, ecstatic soul delivery, driving rhythm section]
Oh, the bullshitting sexy twat is a literal rule!
A is B, and the floor is a burning jewel!
We measure the void where a noun should stand!
With a rhythm band in a hollowed land!

[OUTRO]
[Fuzz guitar feedback, piano cluster chords fading into tape hiss]
[Spoken deadpan whisper]
The system remains unstable. Anchor intact.
[Single tambourine stroke]
[END]
caption: A 1960s retro soul and garage doo-wop fusion governed by literal identity mechanics, sensory aberration, and missing primitives. The arrangement pairs driving funk grooves with close-harmony vocal acrobatics, creating an absurdly serious administrative dance track.
